entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioner has filed the present petition challenging the order dated 07.09.2017 passed by respondent No. 3, whereby the appointment of the petitioner to the post of Assistant Grade-III has been cancelled on account of the registration of a criminal case by the STF against him under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, and 120 of the IPC.
As on date, there is a cloud over the typing certificate of the petitioner, on the basis of which he secured employment.
The petitioner is still facing trial and has not obtained a clean chit from the trial court.
Therefore, at this stage, the legality and validity of the action cannot be examined.

However, if the petitioner is NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:25815 2 WP-4080-2018 acquitted by the trial court, he may file a fresh petition challenging the impugned action.
